items.text: The run stops at a clear exit, not when the model seems finished
items.why: Stop conditions belong to the loop. A reply that says it is finished is not an exit by itself.

items.text: The conversation fits the window, and old turns are summarized
items.why: Context decides what is on the desk for each call, and what is saved from earlier turns.

items.text: Refused requests and overloaded responses are retried after a growing wait
items.why: Recovery is the errors wire: retry after a growing wait, and stop after a limit.

items.text: Each tool validates its input and returns errors the model can act on
items.why: A tool's inputs and its error messages are the tools wire.

items.text: A tool that writes files asks before it runs
items.why: Which actions are allowed, and whether one needs a yes first, belongs to permissions.

items.text: The system prompt says which instruction wins when two conflict
items.why: What the model is told, and which instruction wins, is the control wire.

items.text: Each run is checked against a test or a grader before it is called done
items.why: A done claim is only a claim until a check confirms it. That is verification.

items.text: Every model call and tool call is traced with its time and cost
items.why: What happened, and where the time and money went, is observability.
